MINI-MINUTES FOR DEC-23-2003 9:30 AM FOR DEPT 301

LAW AND MOTION, 301, MOTION TO STRIKE PUNITIVE DAMAGES, SUBMITTED ON DEC-23-2003 BY JAMES L. WARREN. THE COURT TOOK DEFENDANT TOM GINELLA AND MAUREEN GINELLA'S MOTION UNDER SUBMISSION. COUNSEL TO SUBMIT FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: JAMES L. WARREN REPORTER: CHRISTINA PAXTON, CSR #1558

LAW AND MOTION 301, DEFENDANTS GINELLA'S MOTION TO STRIKE PUNITIVE DAMAGES WAS HEARD AND TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION ON 12/23/03. RULING: DEFENDANTS GINELLA'S MOTION TO STRIKE PUNITIVE DAMAGES IS GRANTED; THE FOLLOWING LANGUAGE IS STRICKEN FROM PLAINTIFFS' COMPLAINT: 1) THE EXEMPLARY DAMAGE ATTACHMENT AND EACH AND EVERY SENTENCE THERETO FOUND AT PAGE 6; AND 2) THE PRAYER FOR RELIEF FOR PUNITIVE DAMAGES FOUND AT PARAGRAPH 14.A.(2).
